name: Mondelez Montgomery Sales Distribution Center - Montgomery NY

fieldNotes.truckGate: Two open paved curb cuts off Neelytown Rd into the yard. No barrier arm, sliding gate, or checkpoint pinch-point; no perimeter fence along the road frontage in Street View (2025-08). Open-access facility.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth at either driveway. The only secondary structure is a small office annex attached to the warehouse front, not a gate-side booth.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: No gate, so no remote check-in inferred.
fieldNotes.entryExitSeparate: Two separate driveways off Neelytown Rd serve the property, allowing distinct in/out points.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: 100,300 sq ft sales DC. Street View shows ~8-12 bay doors on the NW building face; additional doors likely on the south/yard face. Estimated band 10-25, count ~14 - flagged uncertain (faces partly obscured at z21).
fieldNotes.dropArea: Large open trailer yard with multiple rows of parked trailers; published spec is 37 truck spots. ~32 trailers counted in imagery, band 25-50.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated trailer-storage yard wraps the south and east of the building, full of parked trailers.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Large open paved yard between the driveways and the dock face gives deep stacking for 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide open yard apron and two driveways leave abundant unused paved width for an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Open paved yard inside the property before the docks functions as a holding/queue area.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Facility sits on a rural two-lane road (Neelytown Rd) surrounded by woods and grass on the edge of Montgomery; clearly Rural.
